newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans firm on U.S. dryness.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans firm on U.S. dryness.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans firmed on dry weather forecasts for the United States, with moderate volume in both spot and May trade, traders said.

Cash sunflower seed rose, supported by both higher soybeans and good oil prices. Spot and March turnover was moderate. Spot maize slipped in good volume trade, mainly with local consumers. Prices were sapped by bountiful supply. April maize was steady. Recent rains in Cordoba and Santa Fe have left the market feeling more comfortable about prospects for maize sowing. January wheat was steady in slow trade, with producers miffed by current prices and playing hard to get.
